title: Robert Williams v. South Texas Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC approved the panel's action dismissing the appeal because it was administratively out of order.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Robert Williams's appeal against South Texas Presbytery as administratively out of order. The record gives no further reason or description of the challenged Presbytery action.
summary: The SJC approved a panel action dismissing Robert Williams's appeal against South Texas Presbytery as administratively out of order. The sparse record does not identify the challenged Presbytery action or explain the administrative defect, so it supports no conclusion about the merits.
